errors.evidence: The color mapping is incorrect. The orange bars represent 'ЕС' (after transfers), not 'България преди трансферите'. The grey bars represent 'България преди трансферите', not 'ЕС'.
The description completely omits the fourth category shown in the legend and chart: 'България' (after social transfers), which is represented by the yellow bars.

The value 40.8 corresponds to the category 'България' (yellow bar) in the year 2019. None of the bars for 2020 have this value. The description seems to be referencing the category 'ЕС', which has a value of 29.5 in 2020.

The value for 'Българският коефициент на Джини преди трансферите' in 2020 is 43.2. The value 34.1 does not appear anywhere in the chart for any category in any year.
